title: Family Sitting on Log by Stream, 1940s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black-and-white snapshot from around the 1940s showing a family of four—a father, mother, young child, and older boy—posing together while seated on large fallen tree trunks near a flowing river. Dense pine trees and a rocky mountain slope rise in the background, reflecting mid-century American family leisure and outdoor camping culture.
